name: Home Area
description: A small house, kitchen garden, old mailbox, and the first path back into village life.

name: Village Square
description: A quiet meeting place with a notice board, benches, and paths to every small errand.
travel_hint: Check notices and talk to neighbors.

name: General Store
description: A warm little shop for seeds, pantry goods, and small talk.
travel_hint: Aoi often knows what the village needs.

name: Carpenter Yard
description: Stacked wood, hand tools, and repair plans waiting for a patient afternoon.
travel_hint: Bring simple materials for repair work.

name: Old Well
description: A repaired stone well where water sounds carry small village rumors.
travel_hint: Listen after repairs or rainy mornings.

name: Riverside Path
description: A low path near the stream. The bridge still needs a little care.

name: Forest Edge
description: Soft shade, mushrooms, and a path that feels familiar even before it opens.
travel_hint: Look for a calm route after the first village repairs.

name: Mountain Hut
description: A quiet hut above the village. Its roof can just be seen from the lower road.
travel_hint: Unlock after the hillside path is repaired.

name: Lakeside
description: A still patch of water where old memories settle in the reeds.
travel_hint: Ask Hana about the old walking path.

name: Shrine Grove
description: A small grove with paper charms, moss, and a bell that has not rung in years.
travel_hint: A quiet secret for later seasons.
